subject: [PATCH bpf-next 3/3] bpf, cgroup: Protect cgroup_bpf state with its own mutex

2026-11-12.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new mutex, cgroup_bpf_mutex, to protect the BPF state in cgroups. The goal is to reduce contention and improve performance by allowing multiple tasks to access the cgroup BPF state concurrently without holding the global cgroup_mutex. Only attach, detach, and replace operations require both cgroup_mutex and cgroup_bpf_mutex, while other operations like query, link info, and release work only need cgroup_bpf_mutex. This change is motivated by performance issues in a Meta fleet where tasks waiting for cgroup_mutex were experiencing long delays.
